messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added `prefers-reduced-motion` rules to disable the cards’ border transition and show the win banner without its pulse. Normal-motion behavior is unchanged.

I didn’t run tests. The changes are in [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css:49) and [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css:38).
